mood.description: Optional short, frequently-updated free text distinct from bio (e.g. current read or mood).

name.description: Display name in natural reading order (given name(s) before family name, e.g. 'Jane Doe', not library-cataloging order 'Doe, Jane').

avatar.description: Optional profile avatar image. Aspect-ratio enforcement (square) happens client-side, pre-upload; no aspectRatio field is carried on the lexicon.

banner.description: Optional profile banner image. Aspect-ratio enforcement (wide) happens client-side, pre-upload; no aspectRatio field is carried on the lexicon.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC datetime with trailing Z when this profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Optional ISO 8601 UTC datetime with trailing Z when this profile was last updated.

personalName.description: Optional full or legal name if different from the display name, also in natural reading order.

main.description: A shared base profile for any Dracome user, published to the user's own PDS as a singleton record. Carries the user's display name and optional biographical information.
